daily_affirmations.affirmation: I AM A CHILD OF GOD.

verse.text: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

daily_affirmations.affirmation: I AM FEARFULLY AND WONDERFULLY MADE.

verse.text: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

daily_affirmations.affirmation: I CAN DO ALL THINGS THROUGH CHRIST WHO STRENGTHENS ME.

verse.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

daily_affirmations.affirmation: I AM FORGIVEN AND FREE FROM ALL GUILT AND SHAME.

verse.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

daily_affirmations.affirmation: GOD'S PEACE, WHICH SURPASSES ALL UNDERSTANDING, GUARDS MY HEART AND MIND.

verse.text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

daily_affirmations.affirmation: I AM EQUIPPED WITH GOD'S POWER TO OVERCOME EVERY OBSTACLE.

verse.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

daily_affirmations.affirmation: THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD; I SHALL NOT WANT.

verse.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

daily_affirmations.affirmation: I AM FILLED WITH THE HOPE OF GOD'S GLORIOUS FUTURE FOR ME.

verse.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
